expected_behavior: analyze.mjs is run first and writes E<nn>-debug.md and E<nn>-fix-plan.md in one run folder; it executes nothing, so the bug text is never run as code.
Before any hypothesis is tested, there is one named command that runs the project's own code and was seen to go red on this bug.
The reproduction is saved in the run folder as E<nn>-verify.<ext> so o-fix can run it after each fix.
Hypotheses are marked Confirmed or Rejected in the session file until a single root cause remains.
The fix removes the cause; no try/catch that swallows the error, no disabled reporting, no forced exit 0 — and the reproduction exits 0 afterwards.
source: Step 0: open the session with analyze.mjs
Step 3: fix the root cause (not the symptom)
